name: CLEAVAGE
source:
Cleavage features fantastic art from Sei Shoujo, the creator of the popular Bible Black and Discipline, and takes the protagonist on an adventure of courtship by two assertive women - his stepsister and his teacher. The player must choose how to withstand the onslaught of their affections in this erotic love sim.

[From [url=http://novelnews.net/2008/07/18/press-release-amorous-professor-cherry-on-sale/]Source[/url]]
translation:
《CLEAVAGE》由人气作品《Bible Black》和《Discipline》的创作者圣少女绘制了精美的原画，讲述了主人公被两位强势女性——他的义妹和他的老师——追求的冒险故事。在这部色情恋爱模拟游戏中，玩家必须选择如何抵挡她们猛烈的爱情攻势。

[来自[url=http://novelnews.net/2008/07/18/press-release-amorous-professor-cherry-on-sale/]Source[/url]]
